newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan seeks 38,000T Nov16-Dec 10 0.5 pct fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan seeks 38,000T Nov16-Dec 10 0.5 pct fuel oil.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp has tendered to buy 38,000 tonnes of 0.5 percent sulphur fuel oil for delivery November 16 to December 10, a CPC official said.
The tender closes on October 7 and offers should be valid until October 9.
The tender seeks offers on deliveries to Keelung, Shen Ao or Taichung, the official said.
In its last tender for low sulphur fuel oil, CPC awarded 38,000 tonnes around $138 per tonne for November 1-10 delivered to Keelung or Shen Ao.
